note: Ep. 17: Gassan-Toda Castle has fallen. The aged Motonari looks back on his life; then a retainer reports that Yamanaka Shikanosuke is not among those who surrendered. Japanese transcribed with faster-whisper large-v3 (tools/transcribe_movie.py, clips re-run with tools/transcribe_clip.py) and corrected by context and the frames; times in seconds from the start of the film (frame = round(t * 15) + 1). Speaker names are notes only (not shown).

subtitles.speaker: Retainer
subtitles.en: Fukubara Sadatoshi and Kuchiba Michiyoshi report that they have entered Toda Castle.

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: The long road to mastering the West... Looking back,

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: it's a wonder I came this far.

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: When I lost my father and brother so young,

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: and was left caught between the Ouchi in the west and the Amago in the east,

subtitles.speaker: Mouri Motonari
subtitles.en: having paid a heavy price, as master of the West.

subtitles.speaker: Retainer
subtitles.en: We have finished going through those who surrendered, but that man is nowhere to be found.
